title: Oracle Cloud HCM Cohort | YECC
description: Explore the early 2027 YECC Oracle Cloud Human Capital Management cohort, including modules, delivery approach, fees, schedule, and enrolment details.
heading: Build your Oracle Cloud HCM| consulting foundation.
lead: Build practical knowledge across HR processes, Oracle Cloud HCM modules, hands-on system practice, and functional consulting foundations.

details.heading: A practical route| into Oracle Cloud Human Capital Management consulting.
details.lead: Follow a structured learning plan with self-paced preparation, assessed practice, expert-led sessions, Oracle demo-system access, and interview preparation.
facts: Monday, Wednesday, Friday or Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM, three days a week

curriculum.heading: Build working knowledge| across 8 modules.
curriculum.lead: The curriculum starts with a foundation in ERP, then moves into the functional modules used across the Oracle Cloud Human Capital Management pathway.
modules: Common Basic Concepts
The Oracle Cloud foundations every functional consultant uses: navigation, enterprise structures, users and roles, setup tasks, approvals and reporting basics.
Global HR (Core HR)
The core of Oracle HCM: workforce structures, the employee record, and hire, transfer, promotion and termination processes.
Absence Management
Leave plans, absence types and accrual rules, and how employees request and managers approve time off.
Talent Management
Goals, performance reviews and talent profiles that help organisations assess and develop their people.
Oracle Cloud Recruiting
The hiring cycle from job requisition and candidate sourcing to selection, offers and onboarding.
Compensation
Salary structures, grades, and the workforce compensation cycles used to plan merit increases and bonuses.
Benefits
Benefit programs, plans and eligibility, and how employees enrol in health, insurance and other benefits.
Oracle Learning Cloud
Courses, learning assignments and tracking of employee training and certifications.
curriculum.includedLead: Detailed self-paced videos cover selected topics in the listed modules, supported by practical checks and trainer guidance.
included: Self-paced learning
Detailed portal videos support the topics covered in the program.
Quizzes and assignments
MCQ tests and one or more hands-on practice assignments reinforce each topic.
Oracle demo access
Use an Oracle Cloud ERP demo system for hands-on practice during the training period.
Interview preparation
Get support preparing for Oracle Cloud Functional Consultant interviews.
foundation: Covers some interesting facts about how ERP projects start, the different roles in ERP consulting, and the components of an ERP system, which are important for building your career as an ERP Consultant.

delivery.heading: Learn on a weekly rhythm| that keeps practice moving.
delivery.lead: Each cycle moves from preparation to hands-on practice and trainer-led clarification.

steps.label: Prepare
steps.title: Complete the scheduled self-study
steps.text: Watch the required portal videos or complete the assigned self-study before each planned session date.

steps.label: Practise
steps.title: Test your understanding
steps.text: Complete an MCQ quiz and one or more portal assignments that involve hands-on system practice.

steps.label: Clarify
steps.title: Join expert-led live sessions
steps.text: After completing the self-study, join live online sessions, three times a week, led by expert trainers.

supports.heading: Build the knowledge and practice| expected in functional consulting.
supports.lead: The program combines product understanding, system practice, interview preparation, and continued upskilling support.
items: Prepare for Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant roles
Build a deeper understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM products and consulting
Develop practical system understanding through hands-on training
Prepare for interviews at consulting companies
Continue upskilling with support after placement

important.heading: Know the commitment| before you enrol.
important.lead: Review the published fee structure, schedule, and expected study time for the early 2027 cohort.
items: Course fee
INR 40,000 including GST, payable in advance.
Placement-reference fee
INR 40,000 including GST, payable only if you are placed through a YECC reference and after the placement.
Live-session schedule
Monday, Wednesday, Friday or Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM, three days a week
Expected daily commitment
4 to 5 hours a day on an average, combining self-study through videos, quizzes and assignments, additional hands-on practice on the demo instance, and the live online sessions.

closing: Get guidance on the Oracle Cloud Human Capital Management cohort from the YECC team.

curriculum.heading: Build working knowledge| across 7 modules.
curriculum.lead: The curriculum starts with a foundation in ERP, then moves into the functional modules used across the Oracle Cloud Financials pathway.
modules: Common Basic Concepts
The Oracle Cloud foundations every functional consultant uses: navigation, enterprise structures, users and roles, setup tasks, approvals and reporting basics.
General Accounting (GL)
The ledger at the centre of Oracle Financials: chart of accounts, journals, period close and financial reporting.
Accounts Payable (AP)
Supplier invoices, payments and the Procure-to-Pay steps seen from the Payables side.
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Customer invoicing, receipts and collections in the Order-to-Cash cycle.
Fixed Assets (FA)
Asset additions, depreciation, transfers and retirements across the asset lifecycle.
Cash Management (CM)
Bank accounts, bank statement reconciliation and cash positioning.
Common Advanced Concepts
Cross-module topics such as subledger accounting, intercompany and period-end activities that tie Financials together.

curriculum.heading: Build working knowledge| across 9 modules.
curriculum.lead: The curriculum starts with a foundation in ERP, then moves into the functional modules used across the Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Management pathway.
modules: Common Basic Concepts
The Oracle Cloud foundations every functional consultant uses: navigation, enterprise structures, users and roles, setup tasks, approvals and reporting basics.
SCM Basics
Supply chain foundations: items, organisations, units of measure and how procurement, inventory and order flows connect.
Self Service Procurement (SSP)
How employees raise purchase requisitions from catalogues, and how they are approved and turned into orders.
Purchasing
Purchase orders, agreements and the supplier master, from order creation through to receipt.
Sourcing
Negotiations such as RFQs and auctions to select suppliers and award business.
Supplier Qualification Management (SQM)
Questionnaires and assessments used to qualify and evaluate suppliers before and during engagement.
Inventory
Item storage, receipts, transfers, counts and stock tracking across inventory organisations.
Product Data Hub (PDH) Overview
How product and item master data is created, governed and shared across the supply chain.
Order Management
Sales order entry, pricing and fulfilment across the Order-to-Cash flow.
